summary: fix(settings): keep the entrypoint through the pair OAuth handoff
description:
FXA-14556

Because:

* The pair flow dropped the entrypoint when it handed off to OAuth.
* Attribution for pairing was lost in metrics.

This commit:

* Merges origin/main into the branch.
* Resolves the one conflict in the Pair Index test file.
* Keeps both test blocks: the entrypoint cases from this branch and the single-OAuth-start cases from main.

The two sides add independent tests to the same describe block, so both stay. Verified with the fxa-settings Pair Index suite (85 tests pass) and `nx lint fxa-settings` (exit 0).
